battlefield_camp.idea: A ruined war camp: a broken palisade ring round a great collapsed tent. Enemies hold the inside, and the tent splits any fight in there in two.

battlefield_graves.idea: Rows of old graves make long lanes running north and south. Easy to walk a lane, slow to change lanes, and the dead can be waiting in any of them.

battlefield_palisade.idea: Two old palisade lines across the field, their gaps not lined up, so an advance has to zigzag from one breach to the next while ranged shoot along the lines.

meadows_camp.idea: A nomad camp: eight felt tents in a ring round the fire, with gaps between them. Fight through the ring, or hold a gap and let them come out one at a time.

meadows_herds.idea: Wide open grass with nothing to hide behind but herds, lone trees and drifts of tall flowers. Ranged shine here; the herds are the only walls.

meadows_rise.idea: A grassy rise in the middle of the meadow, a way up on its north and south. Whoever holds the top looks down on everything; everyone else fights for the steps or goes round.

stormy_plains_scarp.idea: A cliff at the north with a broad terrace of raised ground under it, stepped down to the burnt field. Enemies hold the terrace; there's one stair and one ramp, a long way apart.

stormy_plains_spire.idea: The great rock spire fills the middle of the map and blocks everything behind it. The fight circles it, with split trees and boulders closing the ring in places.

stormy_plains_trunks.idea: Lightning has dropped trunks all over the field, and split trees stand in clumps. Short broken lines everywhere: lots of corners, no long sight lines.

tourney_fields_camp.idea: The knights' camp: a grand pavilion with big ones either side wall off the north, and a roped sparring ring stands open on the party's side. Narrow lanes between canvas, an open floor to fall back on.

tourney_fields_lists.idea: The jousting lists: a tilt barrier down the middle with one crossing, and stands closing both sides. Two long lanes side by side; you can see across the barrier but only meet at the gap.

tourney_fields_range.idea: The archery range: butts side by side at the far end of a long open lane, rows of dummies and quintains down both flanks. Cross the open lane, or creep along behind the rows.
